description: Dept. of Census and Statistics - National Consumer Price Index November - 2018
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for November 2018, published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). This is a statistical announcement falling under general administrative matters, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
